rule: The intended purpose of the device must be described.
A risk analysis must be included.
Each identified risk must have a control measure.
Test results must not exceed their limits.
Labelling and instructions for use must be provided.
The manufacturer's name and address must be stated.
The document must not claim that the device is "100% safe".
A clinical evaluation report according to MDR Article 61 must be referenced.
The applied standards must be listed.
The software safety class must be stated.
